scientific_integrity: An original derivation was reconstructed and checked symbolically and numerically. All conclusions relying on infinite families are proved analytically. No independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; fixed binary Fourier pupil; real symmetric circulant forward operator; Tikhonov saddle right-preconditioning; nonzero data and zero-start unrestarted GMRES. No claim for noisy, quantized, variable, or nonsymmetric noncirculant settings. General singular GMRES theory is acknowledged; possible specialized antecedents remain.
title: Exact aperture-loss stagnation and retained-mode bias in an optical Type-II Tikhonov preconditioner
